scenes.text: The error belongs in the chat. [pause] The password sitting next to it does <emphasis>not</emphasis>.

Say a deploy is failing. You copy the error, and the config, so the bot can see everything. Mid-paste you catch it: a production database password, sitting in the block. [pause] You stop, replace it with REDACTED, and send the rest. The bot can still help. The password never went in.

scenes.text: A chat is closer to emailing a contractor than to writing on a whiteboard in a locked room. Once a secret is in the thread, asking the bot to forget it [pause] does not unsay it.

scenes.text: Before you paste, scan. Keys, tokens, passwords, connection strings, session cookies, customer personal data, internal URLs that aren't public. Replace them with placeholders. [pause] If a secret did go in, treat the paste as a leak, and change that credential. Asking the chat to forget it is not a fix.
